headline: An API request gave up after 11 attempts
detail: HTTP 529. The session recovered with a later request.
recommendation: Re-run the turn. If this repeats, raise CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES (cap 15) or set CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG for unattended runs.

headline: 6 permission prompts for Bash(npm test:*), all approved
detail: You approved Bash(npm test:*) 6 times in 2 session(s). Waiting on you cost 89s of wall clock.
recommendation: Add "Bash(npm test:*)" to permissions.allow in ~/.claude/settings.json, or choose "Yes, and don't ask again" next time.
rule_title: Allow rule would remove repeated prompts

headline: 6 API requests needed retries
detail: 12 failed attempts before success. Worst: 2 attempts, 11.8s lost.
recommendation: Retries are server-side or network failures, so the fix is rarely local. If they cluster in time, check status and consider a fallback model for long runs. If they cluster on one network, check your proxy.

headline: Bash failed 6 times with ShellError in one session
detail: Target: pytest tests/unit -x. Each failure costs a model round trip to read and react to the error.
recommendation: If the failure is environmental (missing deps, wrong cwd), fix it once and record the fix in CLAUDE.md so the model stops rediscovering it.

headline: Hook PreToolUse:Bash averages 2.2s per run
detail: 9 runs. Hooks block the tool call they guard.
recommendation: Narrow the matcher for PreToolUse:Bash so it runs on fewer calls, or move slow work to PostToolUse or an async check.

headline: Skill pdf-report drove 30% of spend
detail: 16 requests, 1 activations, $6.48 per activation. Mostly claude-opus-5 at effort max.
recommendation: Check whether pdf-report needs claude-opus-5 at max effort. Try a lower effort level or a cheaper model for this skill and compare output.

headline: mcp__linear__get_issue returned 28,608 tokens over 2 calls
impact_unit: USD on requests that consumed them
detail: Each result over 10k tokens stays in context for the rest of the session and is re-read from cache on every later request.
recommendation: Ask for narrower results (filters, limits, fields) from linear, or call it from a subagent so only a summary reaches the main thread.

headline: Cache hit rate fell from 98% to 0% after auto compaction
impact_unit: USD on compaction and cache rewrite
detail: Compaction cut context from 232,670 to 14,000 tokens. The next request rewrote the prompt cache.
recommendation: Expected once per compaction. If it happens often, start a fresh session at natural breakpoints, run /compact yourself between tasks, and keep large tool output out of the main thread by delegating exploration to a subagent.

headline: Plugin release-notes loaded in 4 sessions, its skills never activated
detail: release-notes declares 2 skill directories. No skill_activated event names it.
recommendation: Disable release-notes if you don't use it. Each loaded skill puts its description in context on every request (inferred, not measured by telemetry).

headline: Switching claude-sonnet-5 to claude-opus-5 mid-session rebuilt the prompt cache
detail: The first claude-opus-5 request wrote 81,806 tokens to cache and read none. Effort went medium to high.
recommendation: Prompt caches are per model. Pick the model at session start, or switch at a /clear boundary. For a one-off hard step, delegate it to a subagent on the bigger model instead.
